facts: Backend.lua maps completed HTTP status != 200 to xyd.error.ERROR; HTTP 200 maps to xyd.error.OK regardless of JSON error_code.
Backend.lua removes LoadingProxy on completed responses and only uses network retry prompt for request event 'failed', not completed HTTP409.
Backend.lua error_msg path opens a restart/exit alert; firewall body must omit error_msg.
Shop.lua BUY_SHOP success event mutates buy state, adds purchased Backpack item, and may remove purchase material locally.
BattlePass.lua buy/claim callbacks mutate points, purchase counters and claim state only when callback status is xyd.error.OK.
Arena preflight/start callbacks enter selection/battle only when transport status is xyd.error.OK; those session routes remain deferred to Phase2.
message.lua has no recovered message row for error_code 1; private-server sentinel remains non-impersonating.
implementation_scope: Phase1 blocks only Pass102/103 audited non-session unowned mutations. Session preflight/start and terminal settlement are registered but not yet intercepted.
